Ca doping of Nd2−xCa xNiO4+ δ (x = 0-0.3) materials resulted in the tetragonal phase stabilization at room temperature and in a decrease of the interaction of the electrodes based on these materials with the electrolytes.

Ca-substituted Nd2NiO3.5+δ materials synthesized at 1200–1400 °C via the solution-assistant solid state reaction method can be recommended for use as cathode materials in intermediate temperature SOFCs.
